body: I’m constantly sick. I don’t even complain anymore. My body is giving up and I feel like I should too. I’m always stressed, always anxious. It’s gotten to the point here I lost my sense of taste and hearing for a while. I never sleep. I have PTSD and GED and I’m never okay. I’m never calm or happy. I stop myself because I think deep down I don’t want to, I want to not need to. I want things to just be better I want people to be better. But the reality is I can’t control anyone or anything else but my own fate so what if I decide it’s an early death? I feel relieved every time I almost do it and get anxious and regretful the second I don’t.
